verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature that automatically reviews real calls with AI to score quality, flag failures, or analyze resolution. Pipecat Evals runs scripted test conversations against your agent before deployment and checks expected behavior, which is pre-deployment testing, not review of actual calls. Audio recording, transcript capture and latency metrics are developer building blocks a user could feed into their own analysis, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
